intro: Schools are the biggest buyers of playground equipment in Bihar, followed by housing societies in Patna and the parks run by town councils. FunPlay Systems supplies all three. We design and manufacture every piece at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, where we have been building play equipment since 2002, and we send it to Bihar by road.

Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India fixes the equipment on site, either self-standing or grouted into the ground. We supply every part of the state, from Patna, Muzaffarpur and Bhagalpur along the Ganga to Gaya, Sasaram, Dehri, Buxar and Arrah in the south and west. If you run a school, tell us how many children use the ground at break time and their age groups. We will suggest equipment that keeps a large group busy at once and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Heat, fog and floods across Bihar
sections.html:
Bihar has three hard seasons for outdoor equipment. Summers are very hot with dry winds, the monsoon floods large parts of north Bihar, and winter mornings are cold and foggy. Roto-moulded slides and galvanised steel posts handle all three better than painted mild steel, since plastic does not rust and the zinc coating protects the steel. Plan some shade over slides that face the afternoon sun.

In flood-prone districts, raise the play area above the usual water level and choose grouted foundations. Rubber flooring under swings and slides dries faster than soil after rain, and we can supply it with the equipment.

For a big school ground, our Khel Khud structures, inspired by Indian games, give many children something to do at once. Swings, see-saws and merry-go-rounds from our individual equipment range fill the rest of the space. Keep the toddler area near the school building and away from the main cricket or football pitch, so younger children are not in the path of a ball. If part of the ground floods in the monsoon, put the equipment on the highest corner.

Patna buyers can also read our playground page for Patna, and for staff and parents see our outdoor gym equipment in Bihar.

faq.q: Do you supply playground equipment to government and private schools in Bihar?
faq.a: Yes. We supply schools of every size. Share the ground measurements, the number of children and their ages, and we will send a layout drawing and a quote.

faq.q: Which foundation is better on flood-prone ground?
faq.a: Grouted foundations on a raised, well-drained base hold equipment firmly through wet months. Self-standing installation suits paved or firm ground where drilling is not possible.

faq.q: Can you deliver to smaller towns such as Buxar or Sasaram?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment by road from our Vasai factory to any town in Bihar, and our team or a dealer near you does the installation.

intro: FunPlay Systems designs and builds outdoor playground equipment for Chandigarh's sector parks, schools, residents' welfare associations and group housing societies. The city was planned with a park in nearly every sector, which gives children more open space than most Indian cities. The question for most buyers is which equipment will hold up to daily use and both of the city's extreme seasons.

We make everything at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, and send it to Chandigarh by road. Our team or a dealer in north India installs it, self-standing or grouted. We also cover the rest of the tricity, including Panchkula and Mohali, where newer societies plan a play area beside the clubhouse. Send us the size of your park or garden, the age group of the children and a few photos. We will then suggest equipment and draw a layout with the safe play area marked.

sections.html:
Chandigarh summers are hot and dry, and winter brings fog and near-freezing mornings. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic cope with both, and they keep their colour well. Place slides so they do not face the afternoon sun, and keep the play area near the path but away from parking.

Most sector parks are used by children of very different ages, so split the space. A Tiny Tot station or spring riders suit toddlers, while older children want a multi play system with climbers, such as one from our Castle Crest range. Panchkula buyers can see our playground page for Panchkula, and for adults see our outdoor gym equipment in Chandigarh.

faq.q: Can a residents' welfare association buy playground equipment directly?
faq.a: Yes. Associations deal with us directly. Share the park size and photos, approve the layout and quote, and we manufacture, dispatch and install the equipment.

faq.q: How should a park playground be split between toddlers and older children?
faq.a: Keep a separate zone for children under five, with low equipment such as spring riders and small slides. Older children get the taller structures, with enough clear space between the two zones.

faq.q: Do you install playgrounds in Mohali?
faq.a: Yes. Mohali, Panchkula and Zirakpur are all covered. Equipment comes by road from our Vasai factory and is installed by our own team or a dealer close to the tricity.

intro: From the steel township in Bhilai to the power plant colonies of Korba, Chhattisgarh has many planned residential areas with large open grounds, and most of them need a playground. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for these townships and for schools, housing societies and city parks across the state.

Everything is made at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and transported to Chhattisgarh by road. Our installation team or a dealer in central India sets it up on site. Raipur and Nava Raipur bring new housing projects and government campuses, Bilaspur has schools and railway colonies, and Durg has a growing number of private schools. In the forested south around Bastar, residential schools and district towns need equipment that is simple to maintain far from a city. Tell us your site and we will plan for it.

sections.html:
Chhattisgarh summers are very hot, especially in April and May, and the monsoon brings steady rain after that. Slides and decks in roto-moulded plastic stay cooler to the touch than bare metal, and a shade tree or canopy on the west side helps further. Some grounds drain quickly while clay soil holds water for days, so check how your site behaves after rain before choosing the base.

For townships and large school grounds, a big multi play station from our Play Lands range keeps many children busy in one footprint. Raipur buyers can read our playground page for Raipur, and our outdoor gym equipment in Chhattisgarh covers adult fitness in the same park.

faq.q: Can you plan the playground for a whole township?
faq.a: Yes. We can plan one large central play area or several smaller ones spread across the colony. Send the township map and we will mark suggested locations and equipment.

faq.q: How do schools far from a city get after-sales help?
faq.a: Call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or email aftersales@funplaysystems.com with photos of the part. Spare parts are sent from Vasai, and a dealer or our team can visit if needed.

faq.q: Is roto-moulded plastic better than metal slides in hot weather?
faq.a: Roto-moulded plastic does not rust and stays cooler than bare metal in the sun. Shade still helps in peak summer, so place slides away from the afternoon sun where you can.

intro: FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for builders, housing societies, schools and municipal parks across Haryana. The state's buyers vary a lot by region. Gurgaon has high-rise projects where the play area sits on a podium or in a landscaped central court. Faridabad has large public parks and older residential sectors. Sonipat, Rohtak, Karnal and Panipat have growing numbers of private schools that want equipment for several age groups.

We build every piece at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, with in-house design, roto-moulding and fabrication. The finished equipment travels to Haryana by road, and our team or a dealer in north India installs it. Before you order, we send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, so the builder, the society committee or the school management can see exactly what goes where. You can approve it or ask for changes before we start manufacturing.

sections.html: Builders in Gurgaon and Faridabad often need a play area that looks good in brochures and is ready before handover. On a podium slab we usually suggest self-standing equipment, so the waterproofing is not drilled. Confirm the load with your structural engineer first. On ground-level courts, grouted foundations are usually firmer, and we decide the method after seeing the site. Tell us the handover date early. A themed set from our NexLev series or a CoreCraft multi play system gives the area a clear centrepiece. Gurgaon buyers can read our playground page for Gurgaon.

Haryana summers are extremely hot and dusty, and winter brings dense fog. Roto-moulded parts keep their colour in strong sun, and galvanised posts resist rust through the monsoon and the damp winter. Trees on the west side of the play area keep slides cooler on May and June afternoons. Dust collects on slides and decks, so a regular wash keeps them smooth. Rubber flooring under swings and slides is safer than hard paving and easier to keep clean than sand. For adults in the same society, see our outdoor gym equipment in Haryana.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be installed on a podium without drilling?
faq.a: Yes. Many pieces can be installed self-standing on a prepared base. Share the podium drawings and your engineer's guidance, and we will suggest equipment that suits the slab.

faq.q: Do you supply playgrounds for new projects before handover?
faq.a: Yes. Builders share the site plan and handover date, and we plan the layout, manufacture at Vasai and install. Tell us your timeline early so dispatch can be planned around it.

faq.q: Can we choose colours to match our project?
faq.a: Yes. Roto-moulded parts come in 15+ colour shades, and design customisation is available on request. We show the colours on the layout before manufacturing.

intro: Jammu and Kashmir asks more of outdoor play equipment than most of India. Jammu and the plains around it get hot summers, while the Kashmir valley has snow for weeks in winter and frozen ground for longer. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures playground equipment that handles both, using galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic that do not rust or crack in wet cold.

Our factory is in Vasai, near Mumbai, about 1,640 km away by road. We dispatch the finished equipment by truck, and our installation team or a dealer in north India installs it, self-standing or grouted. Buyers in the region are mostly schools, municipal parks, hotels and resorts in Srinagar and the hill stations, and government departments. Share the site size, the age group of the children and a few photos, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Planning around snow and the installation season
sections.html:
In the valley, grouting and concrete work are hard once the ground freezes, so plan installation for the months between spring and late autumn. Order early in the year if you want the play area ready for summer visitors. Snow sliding off slides and roofs is heavy, so clear it from decks and keep children off the equipment until it is dry. Check bolts and swing hangers after each winter.

For hotels and resorts, wooden structures from our NexLev Woody range suit the hill setting. Schools often prefer the low upkeep of roto-moulded equipment. Srinagar buyers can read our playground page for Srinagar and our outdoor gym page for Srinagar.

faq.q: Can playground equipment stay outdoors through a Kashmir winter?
faq.a: Yes. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic are weather-proof. Clear heavy snow from decks, keep children off wet or icy surfaces, and check fittings when the snow melts.

faq.q: When should we install a playground in the valley?
faq.a: Between spring and late autumn, when the ground is not frozen and grouting can set properly. In Jammu, installation is possible for most of the year outside the heaviest monsoon rain.

faq.q: Do you deliver equipment all the way to Jammu and Kashmir?
faq.a: Yes. We send it by road from our Vasai factory, about 1,640 km away, and install it with our own team or a dealer in the north.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: This page overlaps with /outdoor-playground-equipment-manufacturer-in-punjab-and-jammukashmir.html; both target Jammu and Kashmir. Consider consolidating or redirecting one of them. Ladakh is left out because it is a separate union territory.

intro: Jharkhand's company towns were some of the first places in the region to plan proper parks, and they still buy a large share of the state's playground equipment. FunPlay Systems supplies these townships in Jamshedpur, Bokaro and Dhanbad, along with schools, housing societies and municipal parks in Ranchi, Hazaribagh, Ramgarh and Medininagar.

We design and build everything at our own factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. It has in-house roto-moulding, fabrication and quality inspection, and we have been making play equipment there since 2002. The finished equipment goes to Jharkhand by road, and our team or a dealer in eastern India installs it, self-standing or grouted. Tell us about the site, such as a school ground, a society garden or a township park, and the age group of the children. We will send a layout drawing that marks the safe play area around each piece.

sections.h: Plateau, coal belt and what changes between them
sections.html:
Ranchi and Hazaribagh sit higher on the Chota Nagpur plateau and stay milder than the coal belt around Dhanbad, which gets very hot before the monsoon. The whole state gets good rain from the monsoon. In mining areas, fine dust settles on slides and decks, so rinse them every few weeks. Rocky plateau ground can make digging for foundations slow, and a self-standing base is often quicker there. A township with several parks can have all of them planned together on one set of drawings.

Ranchi schools and societies often choose a Robo Romp or other themed multi play system. Ranchi buyers can read our playground page for Ranchi, and for adults see our outdoor gym equipment in Jharkhand.

faq.q: Can you install playground equipment on rocky ground?
faq.a: Yes. Where digging is difficult, we often use a self-standing base on a level, prepared surface. Our team or dealer checks the ground and confirms the method before installation.

faq.q: How do I keep playground equipment clean in a dusty mining town?
faq.a: Wash slides, decks and panels with plain water every few weeks, and check moving parts such as swing bearings more often. Roto-moulded parts clean easily and do not rust.

faq.q: Do you supply township parks in Jamshedpur and Bokaro?
faq.a: Yes. We plan, manufacture and install for township parks and schools across the steel and coal belt. Share the park layout and we will suggest equipment.

intro: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to builders, schools, housing societies, resorts and municipal parks across Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. The two states cover very different ground, from Bengaluru's apartment towers and the wet Karnataka coast to the dry interior and the long Andhra coastline on the Bay of Bengal.

All our equipment is made at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, with in-house design, roto-moulding and fabrication. We send it south by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the region installs it, self-standing or grouted. In Bengaluru most enquiries come from gated communities and schools. Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubballi and Belagavi have schools and city parks. In Andhra Pradesh, Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Guntur, Nellore and Tirupati have growing housing projects and schools. Send us the site size, the age group and photos, and we will draw a layout with the safe play area marked.

sections.html: Mangaluru and the Karnataka coast get very heavy monsoon rain and salt air, so galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts are the safe choice there, with a well-drained base. Bengaluru's weather is mild, but sites are often small, so compact multi play systems work best. Mysuru and Hubballi sit inland and are drier than the coast, with hot summers before the monsoon. North Karnataka and the Rayalaseema region of Andhra are hot and dry, and shade over slides matters more than drainage. Visakhapatnam and the Andhra coast face cyclones, so grouted foundations are worth the extra effort.

Bengaluru buyers can read our playground page for Bangalore, and coastal Andhra buyers our playground page for Visakhapatnam. Schools looking for structures designed by our own team can browse Funplay Originals. For a list of the regions we cover and how our dealers work, see our network. A school in Hubballi and a gated community in Vijayawada need different equipment, so we plan each site from its own photos and measurements. Whichever city you are in, the process is the same: photos and measurements first, then a layout and a quote.

faq.q: Which equipment suits a small apartment play area in Bengaluru?
faq.a: A compact multi play system that combines slides, climbers and decks in one footprint, plus a swing or spring rider if space allows. Share the dimensions and we will show what fits on a layout drawing.

faq.q: Is your equipment safe to install near the sea in Visakhapatnam or Mangaluru?
faq.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist rust in salt air. Rinse the equipment from time to time and follow the maintenance steps we share at handover.

faq.q: Do you install in smaller towns in Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai to towns across both states, and our team or a regional dealer installs the equipment.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Region page with no twin gym page. Linked to the Bangalore and Visakhapatnam city pages and to our-network. Avoided naming the Andhra capital because of its changing status.

intro: Madhya Pradesh sits in the centre of the country, about 690 km from our Vasai factory by road, and it is one of the easier states for us to supply. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, housing societies, municipal parks, resorts and government campuses across the state.

Buyers are spread widely. Indore has a fast-growing housing market and many private schools. Bhopal, the city of lakes, has government campuses and large public gardens. Gwalior and Jabalpur have cantonments, colleges and long-established schools, and Ujjain is a pilgrimage city with parks that fill up during festivals. Sagar, Guna and Shivpuri have schools and town parks that need durable equipment for daily use. Our installation team or a dealer in central India installs everything, self-standing or grouted, after you approve a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Black soil, heat and the monsoon
sections.html:
Much of western Madhya Pradesh, around Indore and Ujjain, has black cotton soil. It swells when wet and cracks when dry, which can tilt shallow foundations. On this soil we suggest deeper grouting or a firm prepared base, and a drainage slope so water does not sit under the equipment. Summers across the state are very hot and winters are cool, especially in the north around Gwalior. Plan shade over slides and decks that face the afternoon sun in April and May.

For school grounds, our Timeless Play structures and CoreCraft individual equipment let many children play at once. Indore buyers can read our playground page for Indore, Bhopal buyers our playground page for Bhopal, and for adult fitness see our outdoor gym page for Bhopal.

faq.q: Does black cotton soil affect playground foundations?
faq.a: Yes. It expands in the monsoon and shrinks in summer, which can move shallow bases. Deeper grouting or a firm prepared base with good drainage keeps the equipment level.

faq.q: How far is Madhya Pradesh from your factory?
faq.a: The state is about 690 km from our Vasai factory by road. We dispatch by truck and install with our team or a dealer in central India.

faq.q: Can you plan a playground for a temple trust or pilgrimage town park?
faq.a: Yes. Parks in pilgrimage towns get large crowds on festival days, so we suggest sturdy equipment with plenty of clear space. Share the site size and expected use.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Distance in the fact sheet (693 km) is a single figure for a whole state; used as 'about 690 km' for the state overall. No twin gym page exists, so the Bhopal gym page is linked instead.

intro: Maharashtra is our home state. FunPlay Systems has made outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, Palghar district, since 2002. We supply builders, housing societies, schools, municipal corporations, resorts and corporates across every region of the state. Being close to the factory makes site visits, dispatch and after-sales support simpler than in most of India.

Mumbai, Thane and Navi Mumbai produce the most work, mainly society play areas and builder projects. Pune has large townships and international schools. Nashik, Aurangabad, Ahmednagar, Satara, Dhule and Malegaon have private schools, societies and municipal gardens. Nagpur and the rest of Vidarbha have schools and new housing. Kolhapur, Solapur and Sangli in the south have schools and town parks too. Wherever your site is, the process is the same. Share the size, the age group and photos, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.html: The Konkan coast, from Palghar to Sindhudurg, gets very heavy monsoon rain and salt air, so drainage and rust resistance come first. Pune and Nashik are milder, with a moderate monsoon. Marathwada, around Aurangabad, is dry and hot. On the coast we suggest grouted bases and a raised play area that drains quickly after heavy rain. Vidarbha has some of the hottest summers in India, so shade over slides and decks matters most there. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle all four, but the base and shading plan should change with the region.

Our project for Raymond in Thane is one example of this kind of work. Builders usually want a play area ready before possession, sized to fit a podium or a landscaped garden. Schools want equipment for several age groups on one ground, and municipal parks need pieces that take crowds every evening. Pune buyers can read our playground page for Pune, and Nagpur buyers our playground page for Nagpur. Adult fitness stations can go in the same layout, and we can show them on the same drawing as the play equipment so the committee sees the whole garden at once.

faq.q: Can we visit your factory in Vasai before ordering?
faq.a: Please call our sales team on +91 902 830 2266 to arrange a visit. The factory is in Vasai East, Palghar district, and our working hours are Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM.

faq.q: Which regions of Maharashtra do you cover?
faq.a: All of them, from Mumbai and the Konkan coast to Pune, North Maharashtra, Marathwada and Vidarbha. Our team or a dealer installs the equipment after it is dispatched from Vasai by road.

faq.q: What do you need from a builder to plan a society play area?
faq.a: The site plan or the play area dimensions, the age groups you expect, and photos of the space. We send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked and a quote.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Fact sheet km (253) is unclear for a home-state page and was not used. No twin gym page exists for Maharashtra. The Raymond, Thane project is linked from the second section.

intro: FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, community grounds, parks and housing colonies in Manipur. Level open ground is easiest to find in the Imphal valley and the towns around it, such as Thoubal and Bishnupur. We also supply district headquarters in the surrounding hills, where sites are smaller and need more planning.

All equipment is built at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and sent to Manipur by road. A local dealer or our own installation team then installs it, self-standing or grouted depending on the ground. Schools, churches and local clubs in the state often share one ground for play, sport and community events. We plan the playground in a corner that does not get in the way of football or gatherings. We also mark the safe play area on a layout drawing so everyone can see the space it needs.

sections.html:
Imphal has mild summers, cold winter mornings and heavy monsoon rain. Low ground near Loktak and the rivers can stay wet for days, so raise the play area and give it a drainage slope. Rubber flooring under swings and slides is safer than bare earth, which turns to mud in the rains. Valley summers are mild, so drainage matters more here than shade. Check swing hangers and bolts after the monsoon, since damp months wear moving parts faster.

For a shared community ground, equipment that many children use at once works best, such as a merry-go-round, a double swing or a structure from our Nature Sparsh range. Imphal buyers can read our playground page for Imphal, and for older children and adults see our outdoor gym equipment in Manipur.

faq.q: Can a playground share a ground with a football field?
faq.a: Yes, if it sits in a corner with clear space around it and away from the goal areas. Our layout drawing shows the safe play area so you can plan the rest of the ground around it.

faq.q: Which surface is best under playground equipment in a wet valley?
faq.a: Rubber flooring on a raised, well-drained base. It softens falls and dries much faster than soil or grass after rain. We supply it along with the equipment.

faq.q: Do you supply hill districts outside Imphal?
faq.a: Yes, wherever a truck can reach. Tell us the location and road access, and we will plan dispatch and installation with you.

intro: A playground in Meghalaya has to survive some of the heaviest rain in the world. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, churches, parks, resorts and housing areas in Shillong, Tura, Jowai and the rest of the state. We plan for that rain from the first drawing.

We build everything at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, using galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts that do not rust. The equipment is sent by road, and our installation team or a local dealer installs it, self-standing or grouted. Shillong has many long-established schools with playing fields, and hill resorts around the state want a play area for visiting families. Tura, in the Garo Hills, is lower and warmer than Shillong. Share photos and the size of the site, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Designing for rain, moss and slopes
sections.html:
Wet ground and moss make paving slippery, so lay rubber flooring under the play equipment and keep a drain on the uphill side of the site. Slides with a closed tunnel stay drier inside, and roto-moulded decks shed water quickly. Shillong's cool, damp air means surfaces dry slowly, so a covered spot nearby, such as a gazebo from our garden decor range, gives children somewhere to wait out a shower. After the rains end, ask our after-sales team to look at any part that has worn or loosened.

On terraced sites, a compact tower such as one from our NexLev Solitaire range packs climbing and sliding into a small footprint. Shillong buyers can read our playground page for Shillong, and for adults see our outdoor gym equipment in Meghalaya.

faq.q: Will playground equipment rust in Meghalaya's rain?
faq.a: Our posts are galvanised and the slides, decks and panels are roto-moulded plastic, both weather-proof. Clear moss and leaves regularly and check fittings after the monsoon.

faq.q: Can you plan a playground on a sloping school ground?
faq.a: Yes. Send photos and a rough sketch of the slope. We often suggest one or two level terraces with compact equipment rather than one large structure.

faq.q: Which slide type stays usable in wet weather?
faq.a: Tunnel slides keep the sliding surface drier than open slides. Children should still wait until surfaces are dry after heavy rain before playing.
